reason: A web GUI skin that applies a neon digital-arcade theme, pixel typography, animated HUD visuals, custom cursor styling, and interaction feedback through bundled CSS, JavaScript, and static assets.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供霓虹数码电玩风格的主题皮肤、像素字体、HUD 动画、自定义光标和交互反馈。
summaries.en: Provides a neon digital-arcade skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with pixel fonts, animated HUD visuals, custom cursor styling, and interactive feedback.

capabilities: Modifies the web GUI appearance and interaction feedback with CSS
Injects bundled CSS into the web interface
Registers a local route to serve bundled fonts and visual assets
Adds animated HUD graphics, custom cursor styling, and pixel fonts
